column1: # The error findings that the OCSF toolkit (v0.9.0, against OCSF 1.9.0) reports on the example records of the action table
# today: action<TAB>code<TAB>attribute. Each is a place where the stored record leaves out something OCSF's class requires
# (api and src_endpoint of API Activity, entity of Entity Management, user or service/dst_endpoint of Authentication) or
# has an attribute the class lacks (user of API Activity). ADR 0030's class mapping names where most of them belong
# (api.request.uid, entity, resources[]); the emitters do not write them yet, and what to put there is a decision of the
# maintainer, not of this file. `go test ./tools/ocsf` fails on an error that is not listed and on a listed one that is gone,
# so this list only shrinks. Regenerate nothing by hand: fix the record, then remove the line.
